$comment: The covered-domains map of « Krizaka first » (krizaka-ui#609, #612; krizaka/.github docs/quality-controls.md §5.1). THE single source: the dependency-cruiser preset generates one `krizaka-first-<id>` rule per domain from it, and the page « Use Krizaka first » of ui.krizaka.com is laid out from it. `refused`: a package name (`dayjs`, also its subpaths), a prefix (`date-fns*`) or a scope (`@tanstack/*`). A Krizaka package (`@krizaka/*`, in node_modules) is the facade and is never checked. Add a domain here, never in a tool's config.

domains.title: Dates, times and local days
domains.use: `@krizaka/intl` (formatting, the local day with `localDay`) or `@krizaka/time` (date arithmetic, a facade created on the first real need: krizaka-ts#76)

domains.title: Data fetching, cache, tables, forms and virtual lists
domains.use: `@krizaka/query` for server state, and `@krizaka/ui` (`data-table`, `form`, `virtual`) or `@krizaka/pacer` for the other TanStack engines
